第0103章：暗流涌动，药力冲关惊四座
夜幕降临，林家大院灯火通明。
庆祝晚宴设在主殿前的广场上，数十张红木圆桌整齐排列，山珍海味摆满了桌面。往年的这个时候，林啸天一定是全场瞩目的焦点，坐在主桌上接受族人的恭维和敬酒。但今年，主位上空无一人，林啸天因为伤势过重被关在房间里养伤，连面都不敢露。
而坐在主桌上的，是一个谁也没有预料到的人——林药尘。
他穿着一身洗得发白的灰色长衫，安静地坐在主桌最末端的位置上。虽然名义上是冠军，但他很清楚，在这个等级森严的家族里，一个旁系子弟即便拿了第一，也永远不会被真正接纳。
“药尘哥，多吃点！“林小石端着一大碗红烧肉屁颠屁颠地跑了过来，小心翼翼地放在林药尘面前，“今天你赢了少主，我高兴！这肉是我特意给你留的！“
林药尘看着那碗油光发亮、香气扑鼻的红烧肉，肚子不争气地叫了一声。他今天打了一整天比赛，消耗极大，确实饿了。
“谢谢。“他拿起筷子，夹起一块肉放进嘴里。肥而不腻，入口即化，是久违的好味道。
“慢点吃，没人跟你抢。“一个温和的声音从旁边传来。
林药尘抬头，看到林震岳不知什么时候走到了他身边。族长手里端着一杯酒，脸上带着一丝难以捉摸的笑意。
“族长。“林药尘连忙放下筷子，站起身。
“坐，不必拘礼。“林震岳摆了摆手，在他对面坐下，“今天的比试我都看了。你那一手药力操控，很精妙。“
林药尘心中一紧。族长果然看出了端倪。
“只是运气好。“他故作谦虚地回答。
“运气？“林震岳笑了笑，“能把聚气境二重的灵气生生抽离，这可不是运气能做到的。药武同修……你是从哪里学到的这种功法？“
林药尘沉默了片刻。他不能说出系统的存在，只能含糊其辞：“小时候偶然得到一本古籍，照着练的。“
“古籍……“林震岳若有所思地重复了一遍，然后点了点头，“不管怎样，你有这份天赋，是林家的福气。从明天开始，你可以去家族藏经阁第三层自由阅读，所有功法武技，任你挑选。“
此言一出，周围几桌的长老和子弟们都竖起了耳朵。藏经阁第三层，那是只有嫡系核心弟子和家族高层才能进入的区域！族长竟然对一个旁系子弟开放了这种权限？
二长老更是脸色铁青，筷子“咔嚓“一声被他捏断了。
林药尘心中却是一喜。《万古药尊诀》虽然已经有了第一层，但后面的层次需要大量的辅助功法和武技来补全。藏经阁第三层里，说不定就有他需要的材料。

“谢族长栽培。“他恭敬地行了一礼。
林震岳拍了拍他的肩膀，意味深长地说道：“好好修炼。一个月后，青炎城会举办五年一度的'青炎药道大会'，各大家族都会派年轻子弟参加。我希望你能代表林家出战。“
青炎药道大会！
周围的议论声瞬间炸开了锅。
“青炎药道大会？那可是整个青炎域最高规格的炼药比试啊！“
“往年都是少主去的，今年居然让林药尘去？“
“他不是绝脉吗？药道大会比的是炼药，他能行？“
林药尘也微微一怔。他当然听说过青炎药道大会的威名——那是整个青炎域炼药师的盛会，获胜者不仅能得到丰厚的奖励，还能被青炎城最大的炼药宗门“丹霞门“收为弟子。
但问题是，他虽然觉醒了药尊系统，能自动生成丹方、提升炼药成功率，但他从来没有真正在药鼎前炼过丹啊！
系统虽然提供了功法和丹方，但实际操作还是需要练习的。就像你脑子里装了一本武功秘籍，但身体跟不上，照样打不出威力。
“族长，我……“林药尘正想推辞，却对上了林震岳那双深邃的眼睛。
那双眼睛里没有逼迫，没有试探，只有一种平静的期待。
“一个月的时间，足够你准备了。“林震岳站起身，声音不大却清晰地传入每个人耳中，“我相信我的眼光。林药尘，不要让林家失望。“
说完，他转身走向主位，留下林药尘一个人站在原地。
二长老阴沉着脸跟了上去，低声道：“族长，让一个旁系子弟代表家族出战药道大会，是不是太冒险了？万一他丢了人，林家的面子往哪搁？“
“面子？“林震岳冷笑一声，“面子是打出来的，不是保出来的。啸天这次输得不冤，他太依赖天赋，根基不稳。而这个林药尘……“
他回头看了一眼远处还在埋头吃肉的林药尘，眼中闪过一丝深意。
“这个少年的根基，扎实得可怕。“

Chapter 0103: The undercurrent is surging, and the medicinal power is overwhelming and shocking everyone.
As night falls, the Lin family courtyard is brightly lit.
The celebration dinner was held in the square in front of the main hall. Dozens of mahogany round tables were arranged neatly, and the tabletops were filled with delicacies. At this time in previous years, Lin Xiaotian must have been the center of attention, sitting at the main table and accepting compliments and toasts from his tribe. But this year, there was no one at the main seat. Lin Xiaotian was locked in a room to recuperate because of his serious injuries, and he did not even dare to show his face.
And sitting at the main table was a person no one expected - Lin Yaochen.
He was wearing a washed gray gown and sat quietly at the end of the main table. Although he is the champion in name, he knows very well that in this strict hierarchical family, even if a collateral descendant takes first place, he will never be truly accepted.
"Brother Yaochen, eat more!" Lin Xiaoshi ran over with a large bowl of braised pork and carefully placed it in front of Lin Yaochen, "You beat the young master today, I am happy! This meat is specially reserved for you!"
Lin Yaochen looked at the shiny bowl of braised pork with fragrant aroma, and his stomach growled unsatisfactorily. He played a whole day today and was very exhausted. He was indeed hungry.
"Thank you." He picked up the chopsticks, picked up a piece of meat and put it into his mouth. Fat but not greasy, it melts in your mouth and is a delicious taste that you haven't seen in a long time.
"Eat slowly, no one will compete with you." A gentle voice came from the side.
Lin Yaochen looked up and saw Lin Zhenyue walking beside him at some point. The patriarch was holding a glass of wine in his hand, with an elusive smile on his face.
"Clan leader." Lin Yaochen quickly put down his chopsticks and stood up.
"Sit down, no need to be polite." Lin Zhenyue waved his hand and sat down opposite him, "I watched today's competition. Your medicine control is very exquisite."
Lin Yaochen's heart tightened. As expected, the clan leader saw the clues.
"Just good luck." He replied modestly.
"Luck?" Lin Zhenyue smiled, "Being able to pull away the spiritual energy at the second level of the Qi Gathering Realm is something that cannot be achieved by luck. Fellow Yao Wu practitioner...where did you learn this technique?"
Lin Yaochen was silent for a moment. He couldn't tell the existence of the system, so he could only speak vaguely: "I accidentally got an ancient book when I was a child, and I practiced according to it."
"Ancient books..." Lin Zhenyue repeated thoughtfully, and then nodded, "No matter what, it is the Lin family's blessing that you have this talent. Starting from tomorrow, you can go to the third floor of the Family Scripture Pavilion to read freely, and you can choose all the martial arts and martial arts."
As soon as these words came out, the elders and disciples at the surrounding tables all pricked up their ears. The third floor of the Sutra Pavilion is an area that only core disciples and senior family members can enter! The patriarch actually opened this kind of authority to a collateral descendant?
The second elder's face turned livid, and he broke his chopsticks with a "click" sound.
Lin Yaochen was overjoyed. Although the "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" already has the first level, the subsequent levels require a large number of auxiliary skills and martial arts to complete it. There might be the materials he needs on the third floor of the Sutra Pavilion.
"Thank you, patriarch, for your cultivation." He bowed respectfully.
Lin Zhenyue patted his shoulder and said meaningfully: "Practice well. In one month, Qingyan City will hold the five-year Qingyan Medicine Conference, and all the major families will send their young children to participate. I hope you can represent the Lin family. "
Qingyan Medicine Dao Conference!
The surrounding discussions exploded instantly.
"The Qingyan Medicine Dao Conference? That is the highest level medicine refining competition in the entire Qingyan Domain!"
"Young Master went there in previous years, but Lin Yaochen actually went there this year?"
"Isn't he Juepui? The competition in the Medicine Dao Conference is about refining medicine. Can he do it?"
Lin Yaochen was also slightly startled. Of course he had heard of the prestigious Qingyan Medicine Dao Conference - it was the grand gathering of alchemists in the entire Qingyan Domain.Yes, the winner will not only receive generous rewards, but also be accepted as a disciple by the largest alchemy sect in Qingyan City, the "Danxia Sect".
But the problem is, although he has awakened the Yaozun system, which can automatically generate elixir recipes and improve the success rate of refining elixirs, he has never actually refined elixirs in front of the medicine cauldron!
Although the system provides exercises and elixir recipes, actual operation still requires practice. It's like you have a martial arts secret book in your mind, but your body can't keep up, and you still can't produce powerful results.
"Clan leader, I..." Lin Yaochen was about to refuse, but he met Lin Zhenyue's deep eyes.
There was no compulsion or temptation in those eyes, only a kind of calm expectation.
"One month is enough for you to prepare." Lin Zhenyue stood up, his voice was not loud but it reached everyone's ears clearly, "I believe in my vision. Lin Yaochen, don't let the Lin family down."
After saying that, he turned around and walked towards the main seat, leaving Lin Yaochen standing alone.
The second elder followed him with a gloomy face and whispered: "Clan leader, is it too risky to let a collateral descendant represent the family in the Medicine Dao Conference? If he loses his person, where will the Lin family's face go?"
"Face?" Lin Zhenyue sneered, "Face is earned, not saved. Xiaotian did not lose unfairly this time. He relied too much on talent and his foundation was unstable. And this Lin Yaochen..."
He looked back at Lin Yaochen who was still engrossed in eating meat in the distance, and a hint of deep meaning flashed in his eyes.
"This young man's foundation is terrifyingly solid."
